nodes.summary: Chargebee is a robust subscription management and recurring billing platform that helps businesses automate their subscription workflow, manage customer churn, and scale globally. It offers a suite of features including usage-based pricing, payment retries and collections, trial and self-serve options, and advanced reporting and analytics.

nodes.name: Subscription Management
nodes.description: Allows businesses to manage and automate their subscription workflows.

nodes.name: Usage-based Pricing
nodes.description: Enables businesses to implement and manage usage-based pricing models.

nodes.name: Payment Retries and Collections
nodes.description: Automates the process of retrying failed payments and collecting due payments.

nodes.name: Trial & Self-serve
nodes.description: Provides options for customers to try the service and manage their subscriptions independently.

nodes.name: Reporting and Analytics
nodes.description: Offers advanced reporting and analytics to help businesses understand their performance and make informed decisions.

nodes.name: Customer Retention
nodes.description: Predicts churn, deflects cancellation attempts, and helps grow customer lifetime value (CLTV).

nodes.name: Revenue Recognition
nodes.description: Helps recognize revenue accurately, ensuring GAAP-compliance and audit readiness.

nodes.name: 60+ Integrations
nodes.description: Offers extensive integration options to seamlessly connect with other tools and platforms.
